third_party_evaluations.summary: Professional DevOps on AWS with policy automation, secret management, and incident response pipelines.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Policy automation, secrets management and incident-response pipelines require delivery decisions, supporting the recorded professional hint; the evidence remains limited to AWS operations despite its enterprise relevance.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Policy automation, secrets and incident-response pipelines are relevant to owning production cloud delivery, supporting professional placement alongside the stored NICCS hint. No recorded hands-on assessment establishes expert execution across vendors.

alex-novak.rationale: Policy automation, secrets and incident-response pipelines are operationally relevant, but the record specifies two years and no demonstrated practical component. That supports associate competence rather than accepting the Professional product label.
